metadata.purpose: Validate existing MCP activity flow infrastructure without requiring rebuilds
metadata.strategy: Use bash + kubectl + curl to test deployed infrastructure

exitCodes.0: All core tests passing - infrastructure functional
exitCodes.1: Core tests failing - infrastructure needs work

summary: Bash validation harness for MCP activity flow. Tests templates endpoint, recommend endpoint with Thompson Sampling metadata, and backend activity logs. No LLM needed - runs kubectl and curl commands to validate deployed infrastructure.
